messages:
Ava: Quick design review 1: table rows + modal pattern + success toasts. Noticed two UX nits: focus not trapped when opening row-detail modal from compact table, and toast appears under fixed header on mobile so it's not visible. Figma: https://figma.com/file/redwood/table-modal-toast-2026

Rafael: repro? I clicked the row in dense mode, modal opened but I could still tab into the table behind it.

Nina: that's likely missing focus trap on the modal mount. Our Modal component uses inert on the background but we forgot to call focus() on the dialog container for this variant.

Tom: also the modal close button is icon-only with no visible label. Axe flagged "buttons must have accessible name". We currently have aria-label="close" but product wants consistent SR copy: "Close details".

Ava: good catch. Also toasts: on narrow screens the toast is anchored to bottom-right and gets hidden behind the fixed console footer. Maybe we should switch toast placement to bottom-center on small viewports.

Rafael: spacing tokens: compact table has 6px vertical padding. That makes icon buttons <44px. Suggest token spacing.icon-action-compact = 6px -> bump to 10px to get min 44. We'll need to audit icons in table cells and modals.

Nina: accessibility plan: add Modal.setInitialFocus(dialog) on open, ensure role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", and trap focus using our existing focus-trap util. Also ensure we restore focus to originating row on close.

Tom: copy changes: change close aria-label to "Close details for {{rowTitle}}". For toasts, make SR text programmatic: aria-live="polite" and include a hidden prefix like "Notification:" so screen readers announce. Visible text stays short.

Ava: layout change: responsive CSS for toasts:
```
.toast { position: fixed; right: 24px; bottom: 16px; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .toast { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); right: auto; } }
```
This keeps toasts above footer and centered on mobile.

Rafael: tests: add storybook stories for modal opened from table (dense/normal) and axe snapshot tests. Add e2e that tabs into table, opens modal, tabs through dialog, closes and verifies focus returns.

Nina: also check keyboard: Escape closes dialog, Tab cycles within, Shift+Tab reverses. We'll add aria-hidden on root content while modal open.

Tom: token PR: I'll bump spacing.icon-action-compact to 10px and add a migration note. Also check tooltip offsets since larger hit targets shift layout.

DesignLintBot: lint results: missing focus trap on ModalVariant=table-detail, toast z-index lower than footer. Please attach failing screenshots to PR.

Ava: action items: Nina implement Modal focus trap + restore focus (PR), Tom update tokens & tooltips (PR), Rafael add tests & stories, I'll validate mobile toast placement and SR copy once PRs land. Thanks :raised_hands:
